dedupe_keys.name: medellin measured and simulated photovoltaic capacitive i v traces

description: The Universidad de Antioquia team publishes outdoor and synthetic electrical-performance data for HIT, monocrystalline-silicon and CIGS photovoltaic panels in Medellin. Measurements use capacitive I–V tracers with different capacitance values and record electrical parameters alongside irradiance and temperatures. The repository describes thirty-four measured weeks, while the article says ten months; exact calendar coverage was not verified. Mendeley version 2 supplies measured and synthetic XLSX workbooks, a Modelica capacitor-tracer model and a Python generation script, all under CC BY 4.0 with free access. Simulated cases are distinct from observations and cover the stated irradiance range of 50–1300 watts per square metre. Coverage is three panel designs at one site, so climate and technology transfer need checking. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating photovoltaic response or testing tracer-induced measurement effects. platform-openmodelica is the documented simulation environment, and model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level tool. Neither data nor model code was downloaded or run.
